tools.description: Find code examples, official documentation, repository discussions or agent skills for a development task.

One page of a repository's issues filtered by state and labels (all given labels must match), sorted by created/updated/comments. Pull requests are excluded unless include_pull_requests is true, so a page may hold fewer than per_page records; pull_requests_excluded says how many were dropped. Each record carries title, state, labels, assignees, milestone, comment and reaction counts, body and timestamps.
Read what visitors said about a campground_id or campsite_id.

One page of a repository's contributors ordered by commit count on the default branch, with login, account type and contribution count. Anonymous (email-only) contributors are not listed. GitHub refuses this listing for repositories with very large histories (for example torvalds/linux), which surfaces as an error naming the reason.
Browse or collect community discussion on a board, then read threads with forum_topic.

Read video metadata, description and any available transcript. Transcript availability is not guaranteed. Not channel listings, comments or timestamped captions. Scrape pricing per successful attempt: 1 credit base, plus 4 for audio and 4 for video (5 for either, 9 for both), before other Scrape surcharges. The wrapper adds no charge; underlying Scrape requests are billed separately at their current rate. Invalid YouTube Markdown may trigger one fresh Scrape call.

## **Pros and cons of Shadcn UI**
- **Accessibility:** Shadcn UI’s components are compliant with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). It supports screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other accessibility features. You can use Shadcn UI to create applications that are both beautiful and accessible to all users

That said, Shadcn UI isn’t the right fit for every project.

web.title: shadcn/ui Accessibility Audit 2026 - thefrontkit
web.description:
But there is a question nobody has answered with data: **is shadcn/ui actually accessible?**

The README mentions Radix UI primitives and "accessibility by default."

## The 9 components that need minor fixes
### 7. Date Picker — month/year navigation accessibility
The shadcn Date Picker (Calendar inside a Popover) is accessible at the date level but the month/year navigation buttons in the Calendar header are icon-only and use small touch targets.

## What this means for you
If you are shipping a v0, Lovable, Bolt, or Claude Code app — or any app built on shadcn/ui — your accessibility ceiling is determined by the 5 components above and the 9 minor-fix components, not by the framework itself.
